resources.string:
The Bedrock files this app exports (bedrock_data.zip and the bedrock_data folder) are copyrighted by Mojang Studios / Microsoft. They are copied from YOUR OWN Minecraft Bedrock and are only for YOUR OWN devices.

Do NOT upload, share, re-upload, sell or put these files in a modpack. Anyone who wants to use the mod must export the files from their own Minecraft Bedrock with this app.

This app and the Bedrock UI mod are not official Minecraft products and are not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
Copies the UI files the Bedrock UI mod needs from your installed Minecraft Bedrock, and installs the mod file you import into your Java launcher. No root needed and nothing is downloaded.
Minecraft Bedrock is not installed. Install it from an official store first.
No mod imported yet. Download the Bedrock UI mod from its official page (with its credits and license), then import the .jar here.
This file is not the Bedrock UI mod (%1$s).
Choose the game folder of your Java launcher: the folder that contains \"mods\" (for example .minecraft in Zalith). Older Bedrock UI jars in mods are replaced.
Start Minecraft Java with Fabric Loader and Fabric API installed. The mod unpacks bedrock_data.zip on first start.
Put bedrock_data.zip in the game folder (next to \"mods\") or leave it in Download.
You picked the \"mods\" folder. Pick the folder that contains it (the game folder).
No Bedrock UI files were found in this APK. Copy the log below and send it to the mod author.
Warning: no UI definitions were found, so the mod may not work. Copy the log and send it to the mod author.
Minecraft Bedrock from an official store
Minecraft Bedrock %1$s was not installed from an official store (Google Play, Amazon, Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi). Install the official game to continue.
Install Minecraft Bedrock and import the mod file first.
